quote: We use a sequence-to-sequence architecture, with different parameter sharing strategies at the encoder and decoder sides for the different features.
datasets: ARZ dataset from the Linguistic Data Consortium (LDC), parts 1-5
models: sequence-to-sequence architecture with Bi-LSTM encoder and LSTM decoder
outputs: The model generates morphological analyses including lemmas, diacritized forms, POS tags, and other morphological features.

quote: Metrics The evaluation metrics we use include: • POS accuracy (POS): The accuracy of the POS tags... • Non-lexicalized morphological features accuracy (TAGS): The accuracy of the combined 14 morphological features... • Diacritization accuracy (DIAC): The accuracy of the diacritized forms... • CODA-based normalization accuracy (CODA): The accuracy of the CODAnormalized, and diacritized, EGY forms... • Lemmatization accuracy (LEMMA): Lemma accuracy... • Full Analysis Accuracy (FULL): Accuracy over the full analysis...

The evaluation metrics we use include: • POS accuracy (POS): The accuracy of the POS tags, of a tagset comprised of 36 tags . • Non-lexicalized morphological features accuracy (TAGS): The accuracy of the combined 14 morphological features we model, excluding lemmas and diacritized forms. • Diacritization accuracy (DIAC): The accuracy of the diacritized forms, for MSA only. • CODA-based normalization accuracy (CODA): The accuracy of the CODAnormalized, and diacritized, EGY forms. • Lemmatization accuracy (LEMMA): Lemma accuracy. • Full Analysis Accuracy (FULL): Accuracy over the full analysis -the strictest metric.
